title: Infinite Factor Structure in Conditional Asset Pricing
summary: Conditional finite factors can yield rich pooled structure; no complete net trading rule. Source assumptions do not establish diversification for our finite futures sleeves.
about: Conditional versus unconditional factor structure of managed portfolios and stocks.
findings: Population theorems and analytical example, not original executable trading performance.
mechanism: State-dependent weights/loadings span additional systematic directions; mean premia require separate assumptions.
build_on: Risk-model/estimator reference only; no current allocation or return trial.
strategy_code: Diagnostic estimators feasible; source does not specify a complete trading strategy.
review_scope: Focused source review: introduction, setup/assumptions, Theorem1, conditional-stock setup, Section5 illustrations/pricing/covariance and conclusion; no independent audit of all appendix proofs.
